hybrid-memory.quote: proposing three parallel stores — a vector store for fuzzy semantic matching, a key-value store for exact fact lookup, and a knowledge graph for multi-hop relationship reasoning
hybrid-memory.reason: A hybrid memory architecture that combines graph, exact lookup and vector search, so it is a direct point of comparison.

ocr-bench.quote: partitions 60+ file types (PDFs, Word, HTML, images, emails) into structured elements (Title, NarrativeText, Table, etc.) with layout ML enrichment, OCR
ocr-bench.reason: An open-source PDF parser with table and OCR support that could be added as a candidate to the benchmark.

vibe-game.quote: The pattern was demonstrated building a Cities: Skylines II–class city builder in Three.js
vibe-game.reason: Shows how to orchestrate agents to build a 3D game, with screenshot quality gates, procedural or CC0 assets and seeded procedural generation.

agent-viz.quote: sessions follow you across terminal, browser (local web UI at `:6767`), phone, and a macOS desktop app; messages, sub-agents, terminals, and files stay in sync
agent-viz.reason: An orchestration layer with a live terminal and web view of running coding-agent sessions.

ocr-bench.quote: converts diverse file formats to Markdown for use with LLMs
ocr-bench.reason: A lightweight CPU PDF-to-markdown converter that could be a benchmark candidate; the entry notes its PDF table extraction should be piloted first.

organize.quote: Supports PDF, PowerPoint, Word, Excel, images (with EXIF metadata and OCR), audio (with metadata and transcription), HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, ZIP files, YouTube URLs, and EPub
organize.reason: Turns saved docs and videos into markdown notes.

hybrid-memory.quote: Structured markdown scaffold + 11-checker drift-detection CLI for persistent AI agent memory
hybrid-memory.reason: A markdown-based memory system for coding agents to compare with; its drift checks validate records against the codebase.

local-llm.quote: compresses the key-value cache in transformer models to 3–4 bits with zero accuracy loss
local-llm.reason: KV-cache compression, with llama.cpp and vLLM plugins, would let long context windows fit in limited VRAM.

hybrid-memory.quote: Vectorization | ChromaDB for semantic search | Text-based search index (.search-index.json)
hybrid-memory.reason: Directly compares a wiki that adds vector search with kb's lexical typed-record approach.

wiki-scale.quote: wiki-lint (health checks across 8 dimensions: frontmatter, links, orphans, staleness, contradictions, drift, and two more)
wiki-scale.reason: Lists the lint dimensions a growing wiki needs, which bear on how long linting takes at scale.

organize.quote: STOW pipeline converting articles/PDFs/meetings into interlinked wiki with source notes, entity/concept pages
organize.reason: An ingest pipeline that organizes saved content into a linked markdown wiki.

vibe-game.quote: Image-to-3D reconstruction skill for Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode that turns a single reference image into a quality-gated, animation-ready TypeScript THREE.Group factory
vibe-game.reason: Generates 3D game art from reference images with an agent.

hybrid-memory.quote: Agentic RAG wraps a vector-database retriever as a tool for an LLM agent, which reformulates queries, critiques retrieved snippets, and iterates through multiple retrieval rounds
hybrid-memory.reason: A RAG retrieval pattern to compare with an agent searching its memory.
